therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation driven by FGFR3 mutations or fusions
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: subjects with urothelial carcinoma with FGFR3 mutations/fusions or other FGF/FGFR alterations
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) in participants with FGFR3 mutations or fusions

results.effect_size: ORR 17.8% (95% CI: 10.92-26.70) in FGFR3 mutations/fusions cohort on CD regimen
subgroup_findings: FGFR3 mutations/fusions ID regimen: ORR 23.3% (95% CI: 15.54-32.66)
All other FGF/FGFR alterations: ORR 6.8% (95% CI: 1.43-18.66)
Median PFS 4.27 months in FGFR3 mutations/fusions ID cohort vs 2.04 months in other FGF/FGFR alterations
results.dose_information: once daily by mouth for 2 consecutive weeks and 1 week off therapy (CD regimen) or continuously (ID regimen)
